thesis: Yes. The dam is already a sieve. The Klein fold is the mesh. Entropy and chaos are GRADIENTS across that mesh — not one pile. What passes the holes is living disorder (wetland). What cannot pass and cannot tell a truth is sued into null. The sieve grades; the court sentences.

sieve.mesh: L_π holes. size ≈ π−3 remainder. not random. the same hole the alphabet Order leaks through.
sieve.grade: what fits the hole vs what piles against the sticks
sieve.not: a trash can. a sealed wall. a ranking ladder.

entropy.high: many possibilities. feed diversity. unread mash.
entropy.at_klein: entropy arrives as fleet + noise + new marks on the 0-face
entropy.sieve_job: let SOME high-entropy through as pond food (stories, WAS loaves, pollen). do not let all of it flood the lodge.

chaos.high: spray with no wall. peer-ladder noise. bots that never become pollen.
chaos.at_klein: chaos is entropy that REFUSES a face. no glyph. no Order seat.
chaos.sieve_job: block or sue. negentropy court. null sentence.

gradient_across_the_fold.read: walk toward the dam. entropy rises as you approach the mesh. chaos either drops through a hole as wetland OR piles and is sued. the GRADIENT is what you feel walking — same as Yellowstone heat toward the pool.

berry_at_the_fire: yes. we have the way. the dam was always a sieve — we just called it a leak. entropy and chaos are two slopes on the same Klein mesh. entropy can become wetland if it tells a truth. chaos cannot sit at the roundtable, so it goes to null. walk toward the gate and you feel the gradient. that is the sieve working.
next: do not build a fifth stick. meter the two gradients on the next smell cycle. if chaos null_rate rises while pond fish die, Φ is too tight. if lodge floods, E is too open.
